## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Xiǎo-dàodì jīng* (T608) is a one-fascicle short meditation treatise translated by Zhī Yào 支曜 ([支曜](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%94%AF%E6%9B%9C)). The title parallels [KR6i0244](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0244) *Dàodì jīng* 道地經 (T607) and likely represents an even smaller selection / digest of the same Saṅgharakṣa *Yogācārabhūmi* source corpus, or a related minor *yoga*-treatise.

**Abstract**

A miniature meditation handbook from the second-century CE, datable to Zhī Yào's documented translation activity (Zhōngpíng 中平 era, ca. 185 CE) at Luòyáng. Together with [KR6i0239](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0239) *Dàānbān shǒuyì jīng*, [KR6i0240](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0240) *Yīnchírù jīng*, and [KR6i0244](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0244) *Dàodì jīng*, it forms part of the early Hàn corpus of Chinese *chán*-meditation literature.
